FEAT-5-S108.title: Allowlist Enforcement and Rejection Handling
FEAT-5-S108.description: Implement strict allowlist checks to reject any tool invocation not explicitly registered, including structured error responses and safe fallback messaging to the agent loop.

FEAT-5-S109.title: Pydantic Validation Error Normalization
FEAT-5-S109.description: Standardize Pydantic validation error outputs into a consistent schema for downstream handling by the agent loop and user-facing responses.

FEAT-5-S110.title: Chat History Injection into Tool Context
FEAT-5-S110.description: Ensure relevant chat history is injected into tool execution context where required, preserving conversational continuity while respecting schema constraints.

FEAT-5-S111.title: Tool Routing Observability and Debug Logging
FEAT-5-S111.description: Integrate debug logging for tool selection, validation outcomes, execution timing, and errors to support traceability and QA analysis.
